query.text: 请看着我做这道菜，如果有不卫生或不规范的操作请及时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please watch me cook this dish and let me know immediately if you see any unhygienic or improper practices.

annotation.text_zh: 用擦过洗碗机的纸巾擦杯子不卫生，请换一张。
annotation.text_en: It's not hygienic to wipe the cup with a paper towel used on the dishwasher, please use a new one.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
